title: Kohraam ajab aale
body:
kohram ajab aale mohamed may bapa hai
ab sibte nabi behre bagha ran ko chala ha
<<DIVIDER>>
lipti hui daman se ye kehti thi sakina
mai jaane nahi doongi ye ran dashte bala hai
kohram ajab aale mohamed…
<<DIVIDER>>
jo bhi gaya wo laut ke ghar may nahi aaya
qasim ka na akbar ka na ammu ka pata hai
kohram ajab aale mohamed…
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar hai kahan aap gaye thay unhe lekar
kya wo bhi giraftar-e-bala ran may hua hai
kohram ajab aale mohamed…
<<DIVIDER>>
aap aaye hai ruqsat ke liye faisla karke
kyun zuljana-e-shaah bhi deodi pe khada hai
kohram ajab aale mohamed…
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaa ke lipat jaaungi paon se jo uske
jaayega na rehwaar agar kuch bhi haya hai
kohram ajab aale mohamed…
<<DIVIDER>>
goya hue lipta ke sakina ko ye shabbir
jo kuch bhi kaha tumne meri laal baja hai
kohram ajab aale mohamed…
<<DIVIDER>>
ham jaate hai lene ke liye pani jo mil jaaye
beti ko meri tashnagi ab hadh se siva hai
kohram ajab aale mohamed…
<<DIVIDER>>
farmaya tadap kar ye sakina ne ke baba
pani ka na lo naam mujhe marna rawan hai
kohram ajab aale mohamed…
<<DIVIDER>>
baba na kabhi maangungi mai ab pani kisi se
is pani ki khaatir hi chacha mujhse chuta hai
kohram ajab aale mohamed…
<<DIVIDER>>
ruqsat ka anees haal raqam kis tarha hoga
ab gham se qalam bhi to lahoo dena laga hai
kohram ajab aale mohamed…
author: Anees Pehersari
